column1: # The harmless stand-in script used to test the lab (not a real sample). Its behaviors are known because it was written for this.
Registers a launch agent that runs a program
Sets a file's dates by hand
Strips the quarantine flag from the file
Runs the downloaded file (it does not; shows what a miss looks like)
Asks a made-up name for its address (eslogger cannot see network traffic; shows what a gap looks like)
